lines: Shaam-e-firaaq ab na poochh, aayi aur aa ke tal gayi
couplets.en: Ask me no more about that evening apart, it came and passed.

lines: Dil tha ki phir bahal gaya, jaan thi ki phir sambhal gayi
couplets.en: My heart found ease again, and I gathered myself.
